messages.subject: Re: Unequal Error Bars
parts:
I think the problem really lies in your usage of position_dodge. Do you really need that? If you get rid of all of them then the plot seems fine. 

If you data is anything like the mtcars data you're using then you might want to think about simplifying the data you're representing further, because if you're dodging because you can't see points behind points then you might have too many points. 

That being said, lines with error bars is pretty standard stuff for representing data and I don't really have a good suggestion because I do stats about as well as an untrained monkey.
